newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai banks agree interbank baht trading range.
newsitem.headline: Thai banks agree interbank baht trading range.

text.p: The Thai Bankers Association said on Wednesday that local banks had agreed to set a baht trading range among themselves of 75 satangs below or above the daily baht-dollar reference rate to be published by the central bank.

"The market is expected to be very volatile tomorrow. So all banks agreed to fix the (interbank) baht trade at 75 satangs above and below the central bank's reference rate," the association's head Olarn Chaiprawat told reporters.

He believed that based on the level of baht trades today, the Bank of Thailand would likely set the daily reference rate at 28 baht per dollar, which was the level at which the baht should be, Olarn said.
